$$ \text{SI} = P \times R \times T $$
Where $ P = 1000 $, $ R = 14\% = 0.14 $, and $ T = 4 $
$$ \text{SI} = 1000 \times 0.14 \times 4 = 560 $$

For compound interest:
$$ \text{CI} = P \left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^T - P $$
$$ \text{CI} = 1000 \left(1 + \frac{14}{100}\right)^4 - 1000 $$
$$ \text{CI} = 1000 \times (1.14)^4 - 1000 $$
$$ \text{CI} = 1000 \times 1.68896 - 1000 = 1688.96 - 1000 = 688.96 $$

The difference is:
$$ \text{Difference} = \text{CI} - \text{SI} = 688.96 - 560 = 128.96 $$

Rounding to the nearest whole number, the difference is approximately 129.
